description:
Number of people receiving each government income-support payment (Age Pension, disability, JobSeeker, youth, parenting, carer, family tax benefit, rent assistance and concession cards) by council area and postcode, per quarter for the last three years.

Coverage: 543 council areas and about 2,630 postcodes across Australia; quarters from July 2023 (September 2023 quarter-end) to April 2026 (June 2026 quarter-end). Period is the first day of the quarter. Current to 2026-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/welfare-payments`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: age_pension, disability_support_pension, jobseeker_payment, youth_allowance, youth_allowance_student_and_apprentice, youth_allowance_other, parenting_payment_single, parenting_payment_partnered, carer_payment, carer_allowance, carer_allowance_child_health_care_card_only, family_tax_benefit_a, family_tax_benefit_b, commonwealth_rent_assistance, austudy, abstudy_living_allowance, abstudy_non_living_allowance, special_benefit, pension_concession_card, commonwealth_seniors_health_card, health_care_card, low_income_card. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
